title: FileComparison
description: Every version of one file the setup has, compared.

path.description: The file, below the data directory.

versions.description:
Its versions: the copies in archives in the order the game loads
them, then the loose file the game uses, then the loose copies a
mod manager keeps back.

archive.description: The archive it is in, or `None` for a loose file.

image.description:
The picture, a PNG or JPEG as a `data:` address, for pictures other
than textures.

modified.description:
When the file, or the archive it is in, was last written, in
seconds since 1970; `None` where it cannot be told.

provider.description: The mod it comes from, if the mod manager knows.

sameAs.description:
The position of the first earlier version with exactly the same
bytes, if there is one.

script.description: What a compiled script says about itself.

staged.description:
Whether it is a loose copy that lies only in the mod manager's own
folder, because another mod's copy is in the game instead.

text.description: The content, for files that are text, up to a limit.

textCut.description: Whether the text was cut at that limit.

ModRef.description: A mod as a mod manager knows it.

id.description: The manager's own identifier of the mod.

name.description: The name to show to people.

source.description: The manager that knows this mod, for example `vortex`.

ScriptFunction.description: One function of a compiled script.

fingerprint.description:
Stands for the shape of its compiled code: two versions whose
fingerprints differ do something different.

kind.description: What kind of function it is.

name.description: Its name; for a property's getter or setter, the property's.

state.description: The state it belongs to; empty for the default state.

ScriptFunctionKind.description: What kind of function a script function is.

ScriptSummary.description: The name and functions of a compiled script.

hasDebugInfo.description:
Whether the script carries the names of its functions; without
them, `functions` is empty.
